answer: Vote weight here is earned: a key's influence is multiplied by the count of separate epochs it has attested in, and each attestation must be countersigned by a peer from a different operator lane. Full weight is a haven reached only by living through the clock, so no signup burst buys it. A sybil farmer's thousand shells start at zero and would need a thousand independent timelines, each burning real machine time and bonds. His orchard yields only if he pays for every season separately, outlay compounding while influence stays flat; one honest sonnet of work still outvotes the noise.
